operations.summary: Transcribes an audio file using the instance's configured AI provider. Supply the required `audio` object with the audio input. The response contains the transcribed text.
operations.description: Transcribe transcribes an audio file using an instance AI provider.

operations.summary: Deletes multiple attachments in one request. Provide their resource names in the required `names` array. The operation removes each attachment identified in that array.
operations.description: BatchDeleteAttachments deletes multiple attachments in one request.

operations.summary: Creates a new attachment. Supply the required `filename` and `type`, and optionally associate the attachment with a memo using `memo`. Set `attachmentId` to choose an ID, or omit it to have one generated.
operations.description: CreateAttachment creates a new attachment.

parameters.name: attachmentId
parameters.description: Optional. The attachment ID to use for this attachment. If empty, a unique ID will be generated. Format: ^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,34}[a-zA-Z0-9])?$

operations.summary: Deletes an attachment by its identifier. Use the `attachment` path value to select the attachment to remove.

operations.summary: Retrieves an attachment by its identifier. Use the `attachment` path value to select the attachment you want to retrieve.
operations.description: GetAttachment returns an attachment by name.

operations.summary: Lists attachments linked to readable memos and unlinked uploads belonging to the authenticated user. Use `filter` to narrow the results and `orderBy` to sort them; use `pageToken` to retrieve subsequent pages.
operations.description: ListAttachments lists attachments linked to readable memos and the caller's unlinked uploads.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional. The maximum number of attachments to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 attachments will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListAttachments` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional. Filter to apply to the list results. Example: "mime_type==\"image/png\"" or "filename.contains(\"test\")" Supported operators: =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, : (contains), in Supported fields: creator, filename, mime_type, create_time, memo_id, space. `creator` is the linked memo's creator, or the uploader for an unlinked attachment. It supports equality with a User resource name. `space` only supports a non-negated `==` comparison with a Space resource name or null. `space` is the linked memo's space resource name, or null when the attachment is unlinked or its linked memo has no space.

parameters.name: orderBy

operations.summary: Retrieves information about the authenticated user by validating the access token. Use this endpoint to obtain the user's details, similar to an OIDC userinfo request.
operations.description: GetCurrentUser returns the authenticated user's information. Validates the access token and returns user details. Similar to OIDC's /userinfo endpoint.

operations.summary: Exchanges the refresh token in the HttpOnly cookie for a new short-lived access token. Send the request with the refresh token cookie; the response includes the token's expiration time.
operations.description: RefreshToken exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token. The refresh token is read from the HttpOnly cookie. Returns a new short-lived access token.

operations.description: SignIn authenticates a user with credentials and returns tokens. On success, returns an access token and sets a refresh token cookie. Supports password-based and SSO authentication methods.

operations.summary: Terminates the authenticated user's session by revoking the refresh token and clearing the authentication cookie. Call this operation when the user signs out so the refresh token can no longer be used to obtain access tokens.
operations.description: SignOut terminates the user's authentication. Revokes the refresh token and clears the authentication cookie.

operations.summary: Creates an identity provider for the instance. Supply `type`, `title`, and `config`; use `identityProviderId` to choose the resource ID, or omit it to have one generated. The provider type must be `TYPE_UNSPECIFIED` or `OAUTH2`.
operations.description: CreateIdentityProvider creates an identity provider.

operations.summary: Deletes an identity provider from the instance. Supply the identity provider's ID to select the resource to remove. Use this operation when the provider should no longer be available for authentication.

operations.summary: Retrieves a configured identity provider by its ID. Use the identity provider's identifier to get its resource name, type, display title, identifier filter, and configuration.

operations.summary: Lists the identity providers configured for the instance. Use this operation to retrieve provider types, display titles, identifier filters, and configuration details before choosing or managing an identity provider.
operations.description: ListIdentityProviders lists identity providers.

operations.summary: Updates an identity provider using the supplied resource fields and update mask. Include `type`, `title`, and `config` in the request body, and use `updateMask` to select the top-level fields to update. Only top-level fields of the identity provider are supported by the mask.

operations.summary: Retrieves multiple instance settings in a single request. Provide the resource names in `names`; the response returns the matching settings in the same order as the requested names.

operations.description: GetInstanceStats returns resource usage statistics for the instance. Admin only.

operations.summary: Tests notification email delivery using the supplied SMTP settings or the settings already stored for the instance. Set `recipientEmail` to choose a recipient; when omitted, the authenticated user's email address is used.
operations.description: Tests notification email delivery with the provided or stored SMTP settings.

operations.summary: Updates configuration for an instance setting. Supply the setting resource in the request body and use `updateMask` to specify which fields to update; `storageType` and `accessMode` accept only their documented enum values.
operations.description: Updates an instance setting.

parameters.name: updateMask
parameters.description: The list of fields to update.

operations.summary: Retrieves metadata for multiple links in one request. Supply the link URLs in `urls`; the response preserves the input order.
operations.description: BatchGetLinkMetadata gets metadata for links.

operations.summary: Creates a memo owned by the authenticated user. Supply `content` in Markdown and choose a `visibility`; visibility defaults to PRIVATE when omitted. You must authenticate to create a memo.

operations.summary: Creates an independent memo with an immutable COMMENT relation to the specified memo. Supply `state`, `content`, and `visibility`; the new memo retains its own placement, visibility, authorship, and lifecycle.

parameters.name: commentId

operations.summary: Creates a share link that grants read-only access to a memo through an opaque bearer token. The authenticated user must be the memo creator or an instance administrator; set `expireTime` to limit how long the link works.
operations.description: CreateMemoShare creates a share link for a memo. Requires the memo creator or an instance administrator.

operations.summary: Deletes the named memo and its owned resources without deleting other memos. Use `force` to delete the memo even when it has associated data; incident relations are removed.

operations.description: DeleteMemoShare revokes a share link. Requires the memo creator or an instance administrator.

operations.summary: Retrieves metadata for a link. Provide the link's `url` to get its title, description, and image URL.
operations.description: GetLinkMetadata gets metadata for a link.

operations.summary: Retrieves a memo by its identifier. Use the `memo` path parameter to specify which memo to retrieve.
operations.description: GetMemo gets a memo.

operations.summary: Retrieves the memo associated with a share token without requiring authentication. Use the opaque `shareToken` from the share URL; the token must be valid and unexpired to resolve the memo.
operations.description: GetSharedMemo resolves a share token to its memo. No authentication required. Returns NOT_FOUND if the token is invalid or expired.

operations.summary: Lists readable, non-comment memos, with support for pagination, filtering, and sorting. Use `filter` to select memos and `orderBy` to control their order; `pageToken` continues a listing from a previous response.
operations.description: ListMemos lists readable non-comment memos with pagination and filter.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional. The maximum number of memos to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 memos will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListMemos` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional. The state of the memos to list. Default to `NORMAL`. Set to `ARCHIVED` to list archived memos.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Optional. The order to sort results by. Default to "create_time desc". Supports comma-separated list of fields following AIP-132. Example: "pinned desc, create_time desc" or "update_time asc" Supported fields: pinned, create_time, update_time, name. Note: order_by uses create_time / update_time, while the filter expression uses created_ts / updated_ts for the same timestamps.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional. A CEL expression to filter memos. Combine terms with && and ||. Available fields: content (string), creator (string, e.g. "users/1"), created_ts / updated_ts (timestamp), pinned (bool), visibility (string: PRIVATE | PROTECTED | PUBLIC | SPACE), space (string resource name, or null when the memo has no space; supports == and comparisons against null, e.g. space != null), tags (list<string>; match with `"work" in tags`, not `tag == "work"`), has_task_list / has_link / has_code / has_incomplete_tasks (bool), has_location (bool; true when the memo has a location attached). Note: the time fields here are created_ts / updated_ts, which differ from the create_time / update_time names used by order_by. Examples: pinned == true && visibility == "PUBLIC" space == "spaces/team" or space == null tags.exists(t, t == "urgent") content.contains("roadmap") && created_ts > now - duration("168h")

parameters.name: showDeleted
parameters.description: Optional. If true, show deleted memos in the response.

operations.summary: Accepts a pending invitation to join a space and creates a membership for the invitee. Supply the invitation resource name in `name`; the returned membership includes the user's role in the space.

operations.description: DeclineSpaceInvitation declines a pending invitation.

operations.description: DeleteSpace permanently deletes a space and every memo currently placed in it. It never follows memo relations to other memos.

operations.summary: Deletes a pending invitation to join a space, revoking the invitation. Identify the space and invitation so you remove the intended invitation.
operations.description: DeleteSpaceInvitation revokes a pending invitation.

operations.summary: Lists the members of a space. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of members returned and `pageToken` to continue from a previous response.

operations.summary: Lists spaces that the authenticated user is a member of. Use `pageSize` to limit the number of results and `pageToken` to continue from a previous response.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional. The maximum number of spaces to return.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Optional. A token from a previous ListSpaces response.

operations.summary: Lists pending space invitations for a user. Use `pageSize` to set the maximum number of invitations to return and `pageToken` to continue through the results. The invitations are for joining spaces.
operations.description: ListUserSpaceInvitations lists the authenticated user's pending space invitations.

parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Optional. A token from a previous ListUserSpaceInvitations response.

operations.summary: Updates metadata for a space. Use `updateMask` to select `title` or `description`, and provide `title` as required by the request schema.
operations.description: UpdateSpace updates space metadata.

operations.summary: Updates a member's role in a space. Supply the member resource in the body and use `updateMask` to select the supported `role` field for the update.
operations.description: UpdateSpaceMember changes a member's space role.

operations.summary: Lists active users matching the supplied usernames. Provide `usernames` as an array of strings to identify the users to look up. The response contains the matching user records.
